column4: /bin/bash -c ' set -euo pipefail cat >"'"$RULE_FILE"'" <<'"'"'EOF'"'"' KERNEL=="uinput", GROUP="input", MODE="0660", OPTIONS+="static_node=uinput" EOF modprobe uinput udevadm control --reload-rules ud ...
bash -c 'IFS= read -r current; drive=$1; shift; exec cryptsetup luksChangeKey "$@" --key-file <(printf "%s" "$current") "$drive" <(cat)' bash "$drive" "${pbkdf[@]}"
sed -i '/^# Btrfs swapfile for system hibernation$/d' /etc/fstab
ufw allow in proto "$proto" from "$cidr" to
ufw allow in on tailscale0 to any port

/bin/bash -c ' set -eEuo pipefail PATH=/usr/bin:/bin export PATH umask 077 # Every check below is a bare assertion that aborts under set -e. Name the # subject of each one so a refusal reaches the use ...
ufw --force delete allow to any app SSH
ufw --force delete limit to any app SSH
sed -i '1i auth sufficient pam_u2f.so cue authfile=/etc/fido2/fido2' /etc/pam.d/sudo
sed -i '1i auth sufficient pam_u2f.so cue authfile=/etc/fido2/fido2' /etc/pam.d/polkit-1
pacman -Sy --needed --noconfirm "${keyrings[@]}" >(grep -vE '^warning: [a-z0-9@._+-]+-keyring-[^ ]+ is up to date -- skipping$' >&2)

bash -c ' shopt -s nullglob extglob cmdline="" for conf in /usr/share/limine-entry-tool.d/*.conf /etc/limine-entry-tool.conf /etc/limine-entry-tool.d/*.conf /etc/default/limine; do [[ -f $conf ]] || c ... ?

bash -euo pipefail -c ' source "$OMARCHY_PATH/install/helpers/browser-policy.sh" browser_policy_setup_dir /etc/chromium/policies/managed for dir in "${BROWSER_POLICY_MANAGED_DIRS[@]}"; do [[ $dir == " ... ?
dd bs=4M status=progress oflag=sync if="$iso" of="$drive"
dd if=/dev/zero of="$1" bs=1M count=100 status=progress
cupsreject -r "Printer discovery has been removed from Omarchy" "$queue"
bash -c 'if [[ -f $1 ]]; then printf file; elif [[ -e $1 ]]; then printf other; else printf missing; fi' bash "$file" ?
busctl --system set-property org.freedesktop.bolt "/org/freedesktop/bolt/domains/${uid//-/_}" org.freedesktop.bolt1.Domain BootACL as
awk ' /^ \/\/[^\/]/ { entry = 1; next } /^ *\// { entry = 0 } entry && /^ (path|cmdline):/ { key = $1; sub(/^ [a-z]+:[[:space:]]*/, ""); print key "\t" $0 } ' "$esp/limine.conf"
sed -i '/^# Omarchy USB authorization begin$/,/^# Omarchy USB authorization end$/d' /etc/default/limine
